nodes.description: Public string state variable holding the token symbol 'cne'.
Public string state variable holding the token name 'connectereum'.
Public uint8 state variable holding the token decimals (8).
Public uint state variable holding the total token supply, set in constructor.
Mapping(address => uint) tracking token balances; written by transfer/transferFrom/constructor.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) tracking allowances for transferFrom.
SafeMath.safeAdd: unchecked addition guarded by require(c >= a) to prevent overflow.
SafeMath.safeSub: subtraction guarded by require(b <= a) to prevent underflow.
SafeMath.safeMul: multiplication guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b) to prevent overflow.
SafeMath.safeDiv: division guarded by require(b > 0) to prevent division by zero.
cneToken constructor: initializes symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and pre-mines the whole supply to the owner address.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Returns balances[tokenOwner].
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Spends allowance from 'from' to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance and then executes an external call to the spender contract's receiveApproval(...).
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, rejecting ETH.
Caller-controlled address used as the balance/allowance owner key in transfer, approve, transferFrom and approveAndCall.
External, user-supplied contract call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) executed inside approveAndCall.

edges.reason: transfer reads and writes balances[msg.sender] and balances[to].
transferFrom reads and writes balances[from] and balances[to].
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
allowance returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
totalSupply returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
constructor assigns _totalSupply = 5000000000000000.
constructor sets symbol = 'cne'.
constructor sets name = 'connectereum'.
constructor sets decimals = 8.
constructor mints the whole supply into balances[owner].
msg.sender determines whose balance is debited in transfer.
msg.sender is the allowance owner key written by approve.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is decremented in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the allowance owner and is forwarded to receiveApproval in approveAndCall.
transfer calls safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens) to guard against underflow.
transfer calls safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) to guard against overflow.
transferFrom calls safeSub on balances[from] and on allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom calls safeAdd(balances[to], tokens).
approveAndCall invokes an external contract controlled by the spender before returning.
The untrusted callee can re-enter the token contract during receiveApproval, before approveAndCall returns.
